candidates.description: This feature vector represents concepts related to robots, automation, and robotic engineering.
This feature vector activates on adjectives describing types of sectors, systems, or environments related to human activity, production, and society.
This vector is related to common Italian verb forms and auxiliary verbs (e.g., sono, hanno, può).
This vector represents common Italian grammatical elements, particularly determiners, pronouns, and adverbs.
These tokens represent contracted or inflected definite articles and preposition-article combinations in Romance and Germanic languages.
This feature activates on the prefix "auto-" and its morphological variations related to automation or autonomous systems.
This feature vector activates on common linguistic roots and prefixes across multilingual subwords related to professional or operational terminology.
This feature vector represents electronic mass media and telecommunication technologies for broadcasting and entertainment.
Foreign-language terms, prefixes, and technical roots related to artificial intelligence and telecommunications.
This feature activates common Italian prefixes and root morphemes, particularly in verbs and nouns associated with action, ability, and change.
